definitions.explanation: A hint or clue planted early in a story, plan, or course of events that becomes significant later. Also used figuratively for preparations laid in advance.

examples.japanese: {伏線|ふくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧。
⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧１{話|わ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伏線|ふくせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最終回|さいしゅうかい}→最終回：26891_saishuukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The foreshadowing from episode one was resolved in the final episode.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{伏線|ふくせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{張|は}り→張る：12583_haru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{巧|うま}くて、⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}かせる→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: This novel uses foreshadowing skillfully, surprising its readers.

notes:
FORMS:
{伏|ふく} (lie hidden) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line) = a hidden line (running beneath the surface).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {伏線|ふくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to lay foreshadowing, to set up a plot thread
- {伏線|ふくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}する→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧: to resolve/pay off foreshadowing

These two expressions are the most essential collocations. {伏線|ふくせん}⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧ (resolving foreshadowing) has become a popular term among fans of manga, anime, and novels.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伏線|ふくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to plant foreshadowing
- {伏線|ふくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}する→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧: to pay off the setup
- {伏線|ふくせん}⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧: the payoff is brilliant
- ⟦{巧|たく}み→巧み：07153_takumi⟧な{伏線|ふくせん}: skillful foreshadowing

USAGE:
Originally a literary and film criticism term, {伏線|ふくせん} is now widely used in everyday conversation, especially when discussing entertainment media. It can also be used figuratively: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伏線|ふくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ (to lay the groundwork for negotiations).
